This enzyme's activity is modulated by the presence of the mentioned compound, which in turn influences the kinase CDC2L2. The observed score of 0.5657 indicates a moderate level of confidence in the relationship between lipoic acid and CDC2L2, suggesting that the pathway may be relevant in a biological context.
